title: Withings now charges new users to sync with Apple Health and other apps | Terra
summary: Withings now requires Withings+ for new accounts to export to Apple Health and Health Connect. Who is affected, what it costs, and what developers need to know.
body_markdown:
**TL;DR:** Withings now requires a Withings+ subscription for accounts created on or after October 13, 2026 to send data to Apple Health and Health Connect. Older accounts keep free export. Withings+ costs $99.50 a year or $9.95 a month, so the recurring fee is now part of the cost of using the hardware. Apps that read Withings measurements through Apple Health inherit the same cutoff, and developers testing with an older account will see a different result from a new one.


Withings now requires a paid subscription for new users to send their health data to Apple Health and Health Connect.


The change applies to accounts created on or after **October 13, 2026** . Older accounts keep free export, whether or not they subscribe to Withings+. The cutoff depends on the account’s creation date, rather than when the device was purchased.[Withings’ updated policy](https://support.withings.com/hc/en-us/articles/203934573-Partner-Apps-What-is-Apple-Health) .


## The subscription becomes part of the hardware cost


Withings+ currently costs **$99.50 a year or $9.95 a month** on the company’s US website. Users can still view their basic measurements and trends in the Withings app without paying. For affected accounts, sending those measurements to another health platform now requires an active subscription.[Pricing and subscription details](https://www.withings.com/en-us/pages/withings-plus) .


That changes the cost of using Withings hardware. Someone buying a scale to track their weight in Apple Health now has to budget for both the device and continued data sharing.


Withings links the decision to its new AI Connector, saying the rollout required API changes and additional privacy measures. Ordinary health-data exports have been included in the same paid subscription as its AI features. Customers who only want their measurements in Apple Health face that requirement too.[Withings’ explanation](https://support.withings.com/hc/en-us/articles/51863040888081-Withings-Withings-AI-Connector-FAQ) .
